verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a self-hostable automation platform, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions telemetry, usage tracking, or any opt-out setting. Self-hosting and bring-your-own-keys claims are adjacent privacy features and are not a documented telemetry opt-out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
